name: Acromioclavicular Joint Osteoarthritis
definition: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the acromioclavicular joint causing localized superior shoulder pain, often aggravated by cross-body loading.

investigations.principle: Radiographs may show AC joint degeneration; imaging findings may be incidental.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

amber: Injection or distal clavicle excision is selective for persistent clearly localized pain.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

patientEducation.summary: Degenerative osteoarthritis of the acromioclavicular joint causing localized superior shoulder pain, often aggravated by cross-body loading.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
